_meta.fields: input = uncached prompt price, cached = cache-read (cached input) price, output = completion price
_meta.scope: Public list prices for PROPRIETARY (API-billed) models only. Open-weight models (gemma / llama / nemotron / gpt-oss / qwen / deepseek / mistral) are intentionally ABSENT: we run them on ANL ALCF/Sophia hardware, so they have no per-token API price. A model with no entry here gets no dollar cost and never wins the 'Cheapest ($)' KPI.
_meta.how_used: Highlights KPI real cost per query = ((prompt_tokens - cached) * input + cached * cached_price + completion_tokens * output) / 1e6 / n_queries. Cached input is taken from the eval metrics when present; when the run recorded no cached tokens, cached is estimated at 60% of prompt tokens (repeated system prompt across the 40-query benchmark). These evals actually run for free through ANL Argo/ALCF -- this is a hypothetical list-price figure for comparison.
_meta.sources: Anthropic: platform.claude.com/docs models overview (fetched 2026-08-06); cache-read = 0.1x input. OpenAI: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (fetched 2026-08-06). Google: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, Standard paid tier, text/image/video input (fetched 2026-08-06).
_meta.context_tiers: Gemini 2.5 Pro and the GPT-5.5 / 5.6-sol / 5.6-terra / 5.6-luna listings have a second, higher price band for long prompts (>200k tokens for Gemini, >272k for OpenAI). The entries here use the SHORT-context band: the 2026-08-04 eval's largest average prompt was ~14k tokens per LLM call, an order of magnitude below either threshold. Re-check if a future benchmark uses much longer prompts.
_meta.caveats: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 is listed at its standard $3/$15; an introductory $2/$10 rate runs through 2026-08-31, so its real cost during that window is lower than shown. Gemini context caching also carries a storage charge per 1M tokens per hour that this schema does not model -- irrelevant here because the eval uses no explicit context cache.
_meta.editing: Add or correct a model with "org/model": {"input": X, "cached": Y, "output": Z}. Keys must match the leaderboard's full model name (org/model). If "cached" is omitted the loader falls back to the full input price (no cache discount).
